snippet.title: Joey The Duck - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Joey The Duck is a linear, open level type platformer game. Join Joey as he explores different locations within one large, diverse level. Don't be fooled by his cuteness - Joey is a materialistic, money-driven duck who embarks on a risky journey through the Forbidden Lands in search of a treasure that may not even exist. There's no main menu, no world map, no hub world - Joey keeps moving forward without pause to get his feathers on that so-called mythical treasure.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3929830/Joey_The_Duck/
